theorems.name: Submission.idtp_cse_rc_af_plane_projection
theorems.statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)) (a e : Euclid P), Module.finrank ℝ Q = 2 → a ∈ Q → e ∈ Q → ‖a‖ = 1 → ‖e‖ = 1 → inner ℝ a e = 0 → ∀ y : Euclid P, Q.starProjection y = inner ℝ y a • a + inner ℝ y e • e ∧ ‖Q.starProjection y‖ ^ 2 = inner ℝ y a ^ 2 + inner ℝ y e ^ 2
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
